result.markdown:
# Poor Accessibility on S-SUD-008 and S-SUD-007

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** bad_change at `S-SUD-008`
- **Confidence:** medium (Timing perfectly fits KPI degradation onset, direct configuration changes identified, maintenance ruled out. External events not checked.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-15 04:00 to not established or ongoing
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-15 04:06
- **Affected:** S-SUD-008, S-SUD-007

## Summary

Configuration changes CHG-2026-0045 on S-SUD-007 and CHG-2026-0046 on S-SUD-008 pushed at 2026-09-15 04:06 introducing RAN parameter template RT-2.4 (admission control, RRC timers) caused poor accessibility and failure rate spikes.

Ongoing poor accessibility affecting S-SUD-008 and S-SUD-007 since 2026-09-15 04:00.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-15 04:00: Anomalies detected with rrc_success_pct drop and drop_rate_pct spike on S-SUD-008 and S-SUD-007. [ALR-0021, ANM-000269, ANM-000270]
- 2026-09-15 04:06: RAN parameter template RT-2.4 pushed to S-SUD-007 and S-SUD-008. [CHG-2026-0045, CHG-2026-0046]
- 2026-09-15 04:25: Minor RRC_FAILURE_RATE_HIGH alarm raised on S-SUD-008. [ALM-000339]
- 2026-09-15 04:37: Minor RRC_FAILURE_RATE_HIGH alarm raised on S-SUD-007. [ALM-000340]

## Evidence

- S-SUD-008 and S-SUD-007 experienced drops in rrc_success_pct and spikes in drop_rate_pct starting around 2026-09-15 04:00. [ALR-0021, T7]
- Configuration changes CHG-2026-0045 and CHG-2026-0046 pushed RAN parameter template RT-2.4 at 2026-09-15 04:06. [CHG-2026-0045, CHG-2026-0046, T4]
- Minor RRC failure rate alarms were raised on both affected sites following the parameter changes. [ALM-000339, ALM-000340, T3]
- No maintenance windows were scheduled on S-SUD-008, S-SUD-007, or their ancestors during the window. [T5]

## Hypotheses

1. **bad_change** at S-SUD-008: confirmed. Configuration changes pushing template RT-2.4 directly preceded the RRC success rate drop and failure rate alarms on both sites. [CHG-2026-0045, CHG-2026-0046, ALM-000339, ALM-000340]
2. **transport_degradation** at LNK-SUD-01-B: rejected. No critical or major transport alarms were present on the link or aggregation router during the incident window. [T3]

## Ruled out

- T5: No maintenance windows were scheduled on the affected nodes or their ancestors.

## Recommended actions

- Roll back configuration changes CHG-2026-0045 and CHG-2026-0046 to restore previous RRC timers and admission control settings.
- Monitor RRC success rate and drop rate KPIs on S-SUD-008 and S-SUD-007 following rollback.
- Verify alarm clears for ALM-000339 and ALM-000340 after rollback.

## Sources

- `ALR-0021`: ongoing alert from 2026-09-15 04:00: 2 site(s) (S-SUD-007, S-SUD-008); region-level SUD; metrics: drop_rate_pct, rrc_success_pct
